etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: Thought to be from 項(うな) (una, “of the neck or nape”) + 突(つ)く (tsuku, “to poke, to push, to jab, to prod”). The tsuku changes to zuku as an instance of rendaku (連濁).

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: Conjunctive form of 行く (iku, “to go”) + shortened form of いらっしゃい (irasshai, “imperative form of いらっしゃる (irassharu)”).
